jobDescription:
Build the Future of AI-Native eCommerce. Built for Operators. Designed for Performance. Unparalleled performance, payment solutions, and flexibility at scale.

Principal AI Engineer opportunity with one of the most innovative AI-native companies in eCommerce.

This is a high-impact role where you'll serve as both a technology leader and AI advocate, owning the end-to-end development of production-grade AI features that directly drive merchant revenue and user experience.

They're looking for someone who has:
- Shipped LLM-powered features to real users
- Strong full-stack expertise with TypeScript, Node.js, and React
- Deep experience building and scaling LLM APIs and AI microservices
- A solid grasp of prompt engineering, RAG architectures, model evaluation, and hallucination mitigation
- Production experience with LLM providers (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, etc.)
- Experience designing distributed, cloud-native systems (AWS or GCP)

In this role, you will:
- Design and deploy scalable LLM integrations and AI services
- Build intelligent merchant-facing features that drive measurable outcomes (conversion, retention, activation)
- Architect advanced prompt and retrieval strategies, including RAG and selective fine-tuning
- Implement experimentation frameworks and evaluation pipelines for AI features
- Help shape the long-term AI technical vision of the platform

Compensation & Benefits:
- $200K–$250K base
- 20% bonus
- Equity
- Fully Remote

This is not a 'bolt AI onto legacy systems' environment. The architecture is AI-native from day one, with a roadmap toward self-healing, self-diagnosing, and self-optimizing systems.

This company is unifying storefronts, checkout, payments, and CRM into a single AI-native operating system built specifically for performance-driven merchants. They've surpassed $10M+ ARR in under two years, are growing 100%+ YoY, and are fundamentally reshaping how modern commerce platforms are designed and scaled.

Product capabilities:
- Decline Recovery: Intelligent retry logic and AI salvage recaptures revenue (+10-20% decline recovery)
- 3X Faster Checkout: Checkouts built for speed, less friction, more completed purchases
- +25-30% Wallet Lift: Wallet-native checkout with Apple Pay, Google Pay, and more
- Funnel Optimization: Create high-performing funnels without code. Drag, drop and preview every element. Dynamic elements for urgency, offers, and personalization. Native A/B testing with conversion analytics. Custom checkout and upsell/downsell flows
- Payment Infrastructure: Secure tokenization, intelligent routing, full visibility, higher approval rates. No-code routing logic builder. Smart cascading and dunning rules
- Analytics and Reporting: Manage entire business from direct sales to recurring revenue. Deep insights for data-driven decisions
- LTV & Revenue Forecasting: Model future revenue by cohort, funnel, or billing cycle using live transaction data
- Cycle Performance Analytics: Monitor approvals, cancellations, and retries across billing cycles
- Intelligent Recovery Triggers: Automate corrective actions when revenue starts slipping. Execute retries, dunning, and routing logic instantly

Company Values:
- All In to Win: Operate with urgency, intensity, and a relentless bar for excellence. The mission comes before ego. Adapt under pressure and do whatever it takes
- Entrepreneurial Spirit: Move like a Day One company — fast, scrappy, and hungry to win. Think and act like an owner with full accountability
- A-Players Only: Only hire people who raise the bar, solve problems proactively, and make the company better every day
- Merchant First: Merchants always come first. Build for their long-term success. Every decision measured by merchant impact
- Engaged Intelligence: Deeply understand what we're building and why it matters. Debate and dissent with respect to find the best answers
emphasisAreas: 0-to-1 product building and shipping to production
eCommerce, sales, and marketing technology experience (including Red Ventures)
Financial services and financial analysis work
LLM-powered feature development shipped to real users
Prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and hallucination mitigation
AI microservices and API design at scale
Entrepreneurial builder mindset and ownership mentality
targetAudience:
Primary audience: CTO — Former VP of Engineering at Skillshare. Scaled to millions of users globally. Led SRE, security, data, and ML teams, achieving 99.99% uptime and rapid delivery. This person values engineering excellence, system reliability at scale, and leaders who can own technical vision end-to-end.

Secondary audience: Head of Performance Products — Technologist and entrepreneur. Founded Blaze SMS and Shop Sheriff, used by 100k+ Shopify merchants. 8+ years in ecom SaaS and millions generated on the Shopify app store. This person values entrepreneurial hustle, shipping products that drive revenue, and ecommerce domain expertise.

Both audiences will be looking for: production-grade AI shipping experience, TypeScript/Node.js depth, ability to build 0-to-1, merchant/customer impact focus, and someone who operates with ownership and urgency.
